description: Yemen: Airports and Seaports is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Yemen. This dataset contains a list of airports and seaports in Yemen including their status (functional, unfunctional, unknown, damaged) and location. Coverage: Yemen. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Yemen. Its tags are aviation, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, ports, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
